description:
A goalkeeper..168cm?!  
Goalkeeper Baek Seung-won was kicked out of the soccer team because of his short stature and transferred to another school. Although he vowed not to even look at a soccer ball, he meets his new destiny when he meets a futsal team called 'Goraniez'.  
Baek Seung-won and Goraniz's hot coming-of-age drama!

**Original Webtoon:**  
[Naver Webtoon](https://comic.naver.com/webtoon/list?titleId=824700), [Naver Series](https://series.naver.com/comic/detail.series?productNo=11097796)

**Official Translation:**
